name: MFDB Diagram - Validator Process
description: Comprehensive architectural pipeline of the BEJSON 104, 104a, and 104db structural validator engine (lib_bejson_Core_bejson_validator.py). Details syntax checking, mandatory keys, custom header restrictions, Records_Type cardinality, 104db discriminator handling, fields type enforcement, field-map cache validation, and values matrix type verification.

shapes.label: Input Source Ingestion
shapes.text:
Accepts JSON string, Python dict, or file path (.bejson).
Resolves file existence and utf-8 encoding (raises E_FILE_NOT_FOUND on missing file).

shapes.label: Step 1: JSON Syntax Verification
shapes.text:
bejson_validator_check_json_syntax
Parses string text into JSON object.
Catches deserialization errors and raises E_INVALID_JSON.

shapes.label: Step 2: Mandatory Keys & Creator
shapes.text:
bejson_validator_check_mandatory_keys
Validates 6 mandatory top-level keys:
Format=='BEJSON', Format_Creator=='Elton Boehnen'.
Verifies Format_Version in {'104', '104a', '104db'}.

shapes.label: Step 3: Custom Headers & Reserved Keys
shapes.text:
bejson_validator_check_custom_headers
104 & 104db: Forbid custom top-level keys (E_RESERVED_KEY_COLLISION; Parent_Hierarchy allowed).
104a: Custom metadata headers permitted.
Persisted '_' keys strictly prohibited.

shapes.label: Step 4: Records_Type Cardinality
shapes.text:
bejson_validator_check_records_type
Records_Type must be a list.
104 & 104a: Exactly 1 record type required.
104db: 2 or more record types required (E_INVALID_RECORDS_TYPE).

shapes.label: Step 5: 104db Discriminator Gate
shapes.text:
bejson_validator_check_record_type_parent
(Active only for 104db; no-op for 104/104a):
Fields[0] must be named 'Record_Type_Parent'.
Every Values row col-0 must match a declared Records_Type entry.

shapes.label: Step 6: Fields Types & Era Restraints
shapes.text:
bejson_validator_check_fields_structure
Validates lowercase types: string, integer, number, boolean, array, object.
104a: Complex types (array, object) strictly forbidden (POL-002).
104db: Fields carry Record_Type_Parent owner.

shapes.label: Step 7: Unique Field Names Check
shapes.text:
bejson_validator_check_field_names_unique
Asserts all field names are distinct.
Duplicate names raise E_INVALID_FIELDS to prevent ambiguous field-map cache resolution.

shapes.label: Step 8: Field Map Cache Integrity
shapes.text:
bejson_validator_check_field_map_cache
_bejson_field_map is an in-memory artifact.
Persisted copy in file/string: rejected with E_RESERVED_KEY_COLLISION.
In-memory copy: whole-map checked against Fields.

shapes.label: Step 9: Values Matrix & Type Checking
shapes.text:
bejson_validator_check_values
Row cell count must match len(Fields) (E_RECORD_LENGTH_MISMATCH).
Strict cell type matching (E_TYPE_MISMATCH).
Python bool excluded from integer and number types.
null allowed for all types (104db padding).

shapes.label: Step 10: ValidationResult Diagnostics
shapes.text:
validate_bejson -> ValidationResult
Returns structured valid: bool, errors: list, warnings: list.
Wrapped by bejson_validator_validate_file() and bejson_validator_validate_string() for boolean pass / error dispatch.
